# Ultimate Lemmings 1.1 RC3 (build 39)
Build: 39 Release commit: a0cb013420965a28bb0d98dfd9f9c21b9d59ab43 Release base: c69663be994a642eff12450db055a3aa5000f498
This candidate fixes the emergency cursor bug from RC2. In Lemmings 3, the game hid the system cursor during pointer capture but did not draw the gameplay reticle when no skill was selected, so the cursor disappeared. In Lemmings 2, a dead reference to a removed `canvas.pointers` property caused the same class of failure.
This candidate also fixes a click-targeting bug in Classic. A follower lemming behind a clicked bridge builder did not receive the selected skill when it stood outside the click's own pick box. The game now searches for that follower near the builder instead of near the click.
This candidate carries the 1.2 content browser feature, already on this branch before the candidate.
## Known issues
- The L2 artwork toggle does not restore pixel-identical rendering after a round trip. See `Tests/SequelMacArtworkAppTests/checks.swift:180`. - A controller button-combo sequence for retry, rewind, and step does not route as expected. See `Tests/AppIntegrationTests/checks.swift:160`.
Both predate this release and are unrelated to its changes.
